content.title: Why Are Sweetgreen (SG) Shares Soaring Today
content.summary: Shares of casual salad chain Sweetgreen (NYSE:SG) jumped 5.1% in the afternoon session after the company announced its debut in Sacramento with the opening of two new restaurant locations. This expansion marked the company's entry into the Sacramento market and continued its nationwide growth. The first of the two restaurants opened its doors, with a second location planned to open later in the month. content.title: Wynn Resorts upgraded by Citi, fast casual stocks pop
content.description:
Market Domination host Josh Lipton and Yahoo Finance senior reporter Brooke DiPalma track several of the day's top trending stock tickers, including Citi analysts upgrading their rating on Wynn Resorts (WYNN) to Buy; shares of fast casual restaurant chains Cava (CAVA), Chipotle Mexican Grill (CMG), and Sweetgreen (SG) popping in Friday's session; and Elastic's (ESTC) stock sliding lower after reporting slowing cloud business growth in its fiscal second quarter results.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Domination.
